import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Load superhero data from CSV
superheroes = pd.read_csv('csv/superhero.csv')

# Load hero_power data from SQLite
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/hero_power.db')
hero_powers = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM hero_power", conn)
conn.close()

# Filter for heroes with Super Strength (power_id=18)
super_strength_heroes = hero_powers[hero_powers['power_id'] == 18]['hero_id'].unique()

# Count heroes with height_cm > 200
count = len(superheroes[superheroes['id'].isin(super_strength_heroes) & (superheroes['height_cm'] > 200)])

print(count)
